thesis.description: Start from one precise prospecting pain and resolve it through a concrete mechanism.
thesis.psychologicalMechanism: Specific recognition creates relevance; a concise solution gives the viewer a reason to continue.
thesis.whyItMayWork: It works best when the pain is concrete, frequent and directly connected to a Vision capability.
whenToUse: One sharp customer pain is known.
The problem can be explained in one sentence.
whenNotToUse: The problem is generic or invented.
Vision only partially addresses the problem and this is hidden.

hook.formula: Name one specific frustrating situation, show its consequence, then introduce the mechanism that removes it.
originalExamples: Tu ouvres dix sites juste pour savoir si ces entreprises correspondent vraiment à ta cible.

story.objective: Show the consequence of the pain.

visual.openingVisualIntent: Make the problem visible or concrete immediately.
visual.proofMoment: The moment Vision directly addresses the named pain.
visualFailureModes: Solution appears before viewer understands the pain.

forbiddenMoves: Claiming all prospecting problems are solved.
commonFailureModes: Pain unrelated to actual product proof.

provenance.abstractionNotes: Initial Vision V1 seed defined during product specification.
